relations.text: CBLが10-Kで、収入の多いテナントの3位に挙げる(59店、収入の2.45%)
relations.text_en: CBL lists it as its No. 3 tenant (59 stores, 2.45% of revenue)

relations.text: Tangerが10-Kで、主要テナントとして挙げる(53店、賃料の3.1%)
relations.text_en: Tanger lists it among its top tenants (53 stores, 3.1% of rent)

source.label: Tanger 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. Aerie, American Eagle Outfitters, Offline by Aerie 53 337,174 2.4 % 3.1 %

relations.text: Macerichが10-Kで、主要テナントとして挙げる(40店、賃料の1.5%)

source.label: Macerich 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: AE Outfitters Retail Co. Aerie, Offline by Aerie, American Eagle Outfitters 40 1.5 %

relations.text: Buckleが10-Kで、主に競合する専門店として挙げる
relations.text_en: Buckle names it among the specialty retailers it mainly competes with

source.label: Buckle 10-K(2026年1月期)
source.quote: In the men's merchandise area, the Company competes primarily with specialty retailers such as Abercrombie & Fitch, American Eagle Outfitters, Boot Barn, Dick's Sporting Goods, Gap, Hollister, Journey's PacSun, Scheels, and Tilly's.

relations.text: Tilly'sが10-Kで、若者向け衣料の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Tilly's names it among teen apparel competitors

source.label: Tilly's 10-K(2026年1月期)
source.quote: We compete with various publicly-traded and privately-held teen-oriented apparel retailers for customers, store locations, store associates and management personnel, including but not limited to Abercrombie & Fitch, Aeropostale, American Eagle Outfitters

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
